{"text":"MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "None of these items meets a need I have right now. The finish nails resemble my recent framing nails, but their gauge and intended use differ; a similar length alone does not make them suitable.",
    "The hanging strips and glues do not follow naturally from my screws and drywall anchors because they serve different fastening jobs.",
    "My medicine-cup purchase does not mean I need disposable gloves, and my vacuum-bag purchase does not establish a need for a bucket or reaching aid.",
    "The caulk caps assume a caulking task that my recent purchases do not suggest."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying nails and screws seems to have been treated as interest in almost any fastening or repair supply.",
    "Individual purchases seem to have been stretched into needs for loosely related supplies without evidence that I have those tasks."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "For nails, the framing application, collation angle, gauge, and tool compatibility matter more to me than sharing a brand or approximate length.",
    "My screws and anchors have specific dimensions and uses; I would need recommendations that fit the same job rather than general decorating supplies.",
    "Replacement vacuum bags need to match the listed Panasonic types. That exact fit is more meaningful than a broad connection to cleaning.",
    "I buy when an item addresses a concrete need; being potentially useful around the house is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognize my interest in practical supplies but miss the specific jobs and compatibility requirements that would make an item useful to me now."
}"}
